value.rationale: The nonlinear odd branch of the classical nonpermuting cubic Dickson map has a natural graph-theoretic unknown invariant: which cycles receive odd tails, and their exact indegrees. This complete infinite-precision classification shows exactly two of ten cycles at each active length receive uniformly sized leaf bundles and gives sharp first occurrence k=8; it is not a mere restatement of known even-cycle lengths or an arbitrary finite sample.
